items.title: EquipmentShare.com Inc. Notice of September 21, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against EquipmentShare.com Inc. for allegedly failing to disclose material information in its January 2026 IPO registration statement and during the subsequent trading period. The company and its executives are accused of concealing undisclosed related party transactions, failing to terminate transactions with co-founder-controlled entities, and providing materially misleading financial statements. Investors who purchased shares between January 23, 2026 and June 23, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit, with a September 21, 2026 deadline to request lead plaintiff status.

items.title: EQPT Class Action Reminder: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the EquipmentShare.com, Inc. Class Action Lawsuit
items.summary: Robbins LLP is reminding investors of the lead plaintiff deadline in a class action lawsuit against EquipmentShare.com, Inc. (EQPT). The lawsuit alleges the company made false and misleading statements regarding undisclosed related party transactions worth at least $77 million involving entities affiliated with company founders. Following a critical report by Umibōzu Research on June 24, 2026, EQPT stock declined over 34.5% from its IPO price of $24.50 to lows of $16.06.

items.title: EQPT LAWSUIT: EquipmentShare.com Inc. Sued for Securities Law Violations; Investors Should Contact Block & Leviton To Learn How They Might Recover Their Losses
items.summary: EquipmentShare.com Inc. (EQPT) faces a securities fraud lawsuit after allegedly making false statements about terminating related-party transactions with founder-controlled entities. A short-seller report revealed undisclosed transactions netting founders at least $77 million, causing the stock to plummet 34.5% below its IPO price. Investors who purchased shares between January 23 and June 23, 2026, may be eligible to recover losses.

items.title: EquipmentShare Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in EquipmentShare.com Inc (NASDAQ: EQPT), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
items.summary: The Rosen Law Firm has announced an investigation into potential securities claims against EquipmentShare.com Inc. following a June 2025 report by Umibōzu Research alleging the company engaged in self-dealing and misrepresented itself as a tech-powered disruptor. The report claimed EquipmentShare's leadership used obfuscation to extract value at shareholder expense. The stock fell 11.7% following the report's publication. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

items.title: EquipmentShare Announces Upsize and Pricing of Private Offering of Notes
items.summary: EquipmentShare (Nasdaq: EQPT) priced a $1.35 billion offering of 7.125% senior secured second lien notes due 2034, an increase from the initially proposed $1.05 billion. The company plans to use proceeds to repay borrowings under its asset-based revolving credit facility and for general corporate purposes. Fitch Ratings assigned the company a first-time BB- issuer default rating with a stable outlook.
